rules.description: Finding IDs are unique.
Occurrence IDs are unique within a Finding.
primaryOccurrenceId resolves to one occurrence in the same Finding.
Step IDs are unique within the same evidenceChain.
rootStepId resolves to one step in the same evidenceChain.
Every primaryPath ID resolves to a step and IDs are not repeated.
Each consecutive primaryPath pair is connected by an edge in the same evidenceChain.
Every edge fromStepId and toStepId resolves to a step in the same evidenceChain.
New producers emit []; every historical nonempty impactStepId resolves to a classification or assessment step.
A break's fromStepId and candidateStepIds resolve to steps in the same evidenceChain.
A complete chain has no breaks and all primary steps and connecting edges are complete.
A partial, ambiguous, or unknown chain has at least one break.
A source file is normalized, project-relative, slash-separated, and cannot contain parent traversal.
Context line numbers are strictly increasing and unique.
Output text respects declared budgets, at most 256 lines and 65536 characters; the default window is 20 lines before and after the hit.
Every highlight line exists in context lines and its one-based exclusive columns fit the line.
Complete code context has at least one line and one highlight.
Every code step kind carries its own source span and context.
Knowledge, classification, and assessment steps do not fabricate source context.
A knowledge_match step includes the referenced entry identity, category, symbol, producer, source digest, and provenance.
The report states staticAnalysisOnly=true and compiled/linked/testsExecuted=false.
All collections follow the ordering declared by scan-result-v2-vocabulary.json.
